explanation: Format by repeatedly extracting decimal digits from the absolute value, then reverse the digits and optional sign. Parse by accumulating base-10 digits after an optional sign. Number exactly represents all signed 32-bit values and their absolute magnitudes.
timeComplexity: O(d) time for d decimal digits.
spaceComplexity: O(d) formatting space; O(1) parsing space.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
